third_party_evaluations.summary: German/EU-focused expert info-sec cert covering BSI IT-Grundschutz, NIS-2, GDPR; proctored by DEKRA/TÜV Rheinland.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced expert: 2, professional: 1. The ordered median is expert. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Recorded senior rigor and broad German/EU regulatory security coverage support expert advisory judgment at five years; regional recognition does not establish Japanese statutory equivalence or hands-on technical depth.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Recorded senior rigor and broad BSI, NIS-2 and GDPR scope support expert regional information-security judgment with a five-year profile. Its German/EU focus and lack of practical detail limit direct US operational hiring assurance.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded BSI, NIS-2 and GDPR coverage is particularly relevant to EU security advice, with a five-year profile and senior scope. The unspecified proctored assessment does not establish enough applied senior evidence to accept the expert hint.
